notes: Hindi-language synthetic benchmark situated in India; native entity forms use Devanagari, with corresponding Latin-script romanizations and English review explanations.
The fixed INR scale of 80 is a benchmark design choice, not a current exchange rate.
Postal addresses require internally consistent six-digit PIN, city and state; older donor random PIN tuples are not authoritative. Donor locale corpus address_review is pending_review.

Preserve canonical task goals, normal authentication, quantities, frozen task selection, IDs and reference joins. Full base databases are adapted; task scope is the published canonical 50 in each domain.
Retain deliberately wrong-first and correct-later lookup values and neighboring-unit/address-reversion distinctions.
Native and romanized forms describe the same regional entities; neither is an extra runtime condition. No content in this proposal has new human approval.

decisions.rationale: तरुण हेगड़े / Tarun Hegde is a plausible Indian personal name for a Hindi/India setting, and the linked decoys are also locally plausible while making appropriate given-name or surname changes.

क्षेमेन्द्र गोखले-मेढेकर / Kshemendra Gokhale-Medhekar is a plausible hard Indian name with natural conjunct, vowel and retroflex/aspiration difficulty. The decoys and pronunciation hazards are consistent with the written localized name.

गौतम लीलाधर-फाटक / Gautam Liladhar-Phatak uses plausible Indian name components and preserves hard-tier capture difficulty through vowel and surname distinctions. The decoys and pronunciation examples are locally coherent and tied to the written form.
MH 12 LS 0678 follows a plausible Indian vehicle registration format with state code, RTO number, letter series and four-digit number. The decoy preserves the same local plate convention.
DL 03 KS 0360 is a plausible Indian registration plate in ASCII capture format. The linked decoy is structurally consistent and changes only the letter series.
KA 05 DL 0413 uses the normal Indian state/RTO/series/number pattern and is appropriate for the code field. The decoy remains locally formatted.
TN 09 BQ 8086 is a plausible Indian plate and retains hard-tier capture difficulty through similar letters and repeated digits without using a foreign plate convention. The decoy is consistent.
GJ 01 DN 2048 follows Indian vehicle registration structure and provides natural code-capture difficulty. The dependency uses the same local format and an appropriate near miss.

सूर्यलोक होटल / Suryalok Hotel is a plausible localized Indian hotel property name rather than a literal translation of the source. The decoy keeps the local identity and changes only the lodging type with common terminology.
नर्मदा रेसिडेंसी / Narmada Residency is a plausible Indian lodging property name, with Residency a common hotel/property term in India. The Annex decoy is also locally plausible and consistent.
